description: The entries that make up a report — what its datagrid widget or an export would show, keyed by field API ID. Wufoo documents no paging or filter parameters for this endpoint. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/entries.json.

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

system.description: Include system metadata (IP, LastPage, CompleteSubmission, payment Status/PurchaseTotal/Currency/TransactionId/MerchantType).

name: wufoo_list_report_entries
title: List report entries
